text:
Astra so good that now OpenAI can have my $20 subscription back.

I cancelled my OpenAI subscription many months ago after I figured out the Github Copilot had the best deal before M$FT nerfed it.  GLM was the best deal for the next while but now they are changing to credit based pricing too

The cheap tokens gravy train is leaving the station, burn baby burn while you still have it.
